CustomField.description: Status of the Call for Offers on this deal. Open by default; stamped Submitted/Closed by the team. Suppresses the T-minus-due-date alert ladder once Submitted or Closed (OpportunitySelector.queryCallForOffersAlerts). Also stamped Open by CallForOffersStampService when Offer_Due_Date__c first appears on an existing deal, since the picklist <default> only applies on insert.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Open = offer not yet sent. Submitted = your offer has gone out. Closed = the Call for Offers window is done (won, lost, or withdrawn). Submitted/Closed stop the due-date reminder.
CustomField.label: Offer Status
